ga_manager_statement.source: The Legal information page, the About page and the Important Disclosures page say nothing about who manages the companies' investment portfolio. The 2025 Climate Risk Management Report says only 'The Companies monitor their investment portfolio and report on carbon emissions associated with their investment activities.'

operating_entities.note: 'Securian Canada' is a brand, not a legal entity; it is kept as a node because the page itself structures the disclosure that way (brand used by the two underwriting companies, each described as an independent subsidiary of Securian Financial Group, Inc.). The page does not list Valeyo Inc. (services affiliate named as 'sister company' in a 2023 press release) or Securian Asset Management, so they are excluded per the brief. Same text appears in the footer of every securiancanada.ca page and on the Important Disclosures page (https://www.securiancanada.ca/en-ca/important-disclosures).

cio.title: No chief investment officer or investment executive disclosed for the Canadian companies
cio.note: The leadership page lists five executives (CEO, CTO/CISO, Chief Human Experience Officer, Chief Legal Officer, CFO) and none with an investment title; the CFO oversees 'finance, actuarial and procurement'. The 2025 climate report says only that 'The Companies monitor their investment portfolio'. Investment management is most likely delegated to the parent's Securian Asset Management, Inc. (St. Paul, MN; parent CIO John Heshelman since May 2025 per a June 2025 Securian Financial release surfaced in search), but no public source confirms that it manages the Canadian general account, so the CIO is left unnamed and the direct-report list empty.

notes: Securian Canada's Legal information page is a clean 'underwritten by' disclosure: the brand is used by Canadian Premier Life Insurance Company (Ontario-domiciled) and Canadian Premier General Insurance Company, each an independent subsidiary of Securian Financial Group, Inc.; no other affiliates are listed there. The Canadian ELT (Branker CEO since 2022-04; Peliel CFO since 2026-03 over finance, actuarial and procurement; Geldernick CLO since early 2024 over legal, compliance and risk; Mazhar CTO/CISO; Theodorou CHXO) contains no investment executive, consistent with a disclosure-light creditor/affinity insurer whose C$0.7bn public-market portfolio is presumably run by the US parent's asset manager. Personal library not available in this session; public sources used. Bigdata.com and Firecrawl not used per brief.
